extraFacts.fact: SAE J514 and ISO 8434-2 cover 37° flared tube and hose fittings (JIC): the male 37° flare seats metal to metal against the 37° cone of the female swivel nut, and thread sizes are given by dash number, where each dash is one sixteenth of an inch (-04 is 4/16 in, or 1/4 in).

ASME B1.20.1 covers general-purpose inch pipe threads: NPT is a taper thread with a 60° thread form that seals on the threads, and NPSM is a straight (parallel) thread for free-fitting mechanical joints that does not seal on the thread.

ISO 228-1 specifies pipe threads, designated G, where pressure-tight joints are not made on the threads: both the external and internal thread are parallel (BSPP). The seal is made by a washer, O-ring, bonded seal or sealing face, not by the thread flanks.

316L is the low-carbon grade of 316 austenitic stainless steel (carbon 0.03 % maximum), which is why it can be welded without carbide precipitation at the grain boundaries; it contains molybdenum for resistance to chloride pitting.
extraFacts.source: ASTM A240 / A276 chemical composition limits for UNS S31603

faqs.a: The male NPT swivel screws into a female NPT port and seals on the thread with sealant, with the swivel stopping the hose from twisting. The [Stainless Steel Push-On Hose Fitting × NPT Female Swivel](/p/stainless-steel-push-on-hose-fitting-x-npt-female-swivel) is the female swivel.

faqs.q: How do I fit a push-on NPT male swivel without twisting the hose?
faqs.a: Push the hose fully onto the stem as the hose maker advises, then screw the male thread into the port with sealant suited to stainless, turning only the swivel body so the hose stays put. Tighten by turns and do not over-tighten. See the [stainless hose barbs and push-on fittings shelf](/c/stainless-hose-barbs-push-on-fittings).

faqs.q: Push-on NPT male swivel or push-on NPT female swivel: how do I choose?
faqs.a: The male swivel screws into a female NPT port, while the [Stainless Steel Push-On Hose Fitting × NPT Female Swivel](/p/stainless-steel-push-on-hose-fitting-x-npt-female-swivel) screws onto a male NPT thread. Identify the gender of the equipment port first.
